text.en:
The National Cooperatives and Small Busi-
ness Corporation into which the former National Coopera-
tives Administration created under Commonwealth Act
No. 713, approved November 1, 1945, was converted under
Executive Order No. 93 dated October 4, 1947, is hereby
abolished, and its powers, duties and functions are hereby
transferred to, vested in, and assumed by the Cooperatives
Administration Office under the Department of Commerce
and Industry.

There is hereby created under the administrative
supervision of the Department of Commerce and Industry
an office to be known as Cooperatives Administration Office
to handle the various phases of the activities presently
undertaken by the National Cooperatives and Small
Business Corporation. The Cooperatives Administration
Office shall have the following positions and allotments
for sundry expenses in lieu of those provided for the
National Cooperatives and Small Business Corporation in
its current principal special budget:

So much of the present personnel of the Nation-
al Cooperatives and Small Business Corporation as may be
necessary and convenient shall be appointed in the Co-
operatives Administration Office in accordance with the
Civil Service rules and regulations: Provided, That any
of the present personnel of the Corporation not so appointed
in the Cooperatives Administration Office, unless he re-

5290
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
fuses to serve if retained, shall be paid from the funds
of the Corporation herein transferred and available for
the purpose. a gratuity in a lump sum equivalent to one
month salary for every year of continuous satisfactory
service rendered but not exceeding twelve months, on the
basis of the last salary received: Provided, further, That
any official or employee who has rendered less than one
year of service shall be entitled to a gratuity of one-half
of one month's salary: And provided, finally, That in case
of subscquent reinstatment in the government service
or ir any gevernment-owned or controlled corporation,
he shall refund to the National Government the value of
the gratuity which he would not yet have received had it
been paid to him in monthly installments.

All the records, properties, equipment, assets,
rights, choses in action, obligations and liabilities of the
National Cooperatives and Small Business Corporation
abolished under this Order are hereby transferred to, and
assumed by, the Cooperatives Administration Office.

Commonwealth Act No. 713, approved November
1, 1945, and all acts or parts of acts and executive orders,
administrative orders or parts thereof, which are in-
consistent with the provisions of this Order are hereby
repealed or modified accordingly.

This Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 10th day of November,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty, and
of the Independence of the Philippines, the fifth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
TEODORO EVANGELISTA
Executive Secretary
